definition: The lighting contrast between key and fill, a scene-light property.

not_the_same_as.vec_black_level: Black level is the floor. Ratio is lighting contrast.
not_the_same_as.vec_shadow_density: Ratio is how the scene is lit. Density can be a grade on the same lighting.
not_the_same_as.vec_source_hardness: Hardness is the shadow-edge transfer. Ratio is fill strength versus key.

open_questions: Can ratio rise on the teapot without a new hard window?

prompt_phrases.high: weak fill, high key-to-fill ratio, key still from the same side, no new lamps
prompt_phrases.low: strong fill, flat lighting ratio, key still from the same side

scoring_guidance: 0.00 flat fill, 0.50 natural ratio, 1.00 unfilled key.
testable_claim: Raising the ratio deepens lighting shadows without a required tone-curve change.
